description: Removes a specific starred board (identified by `idBoardStar`) from a Trello member's (identified by `idMember`) list of favorites; `idBoardStar` must be an existing star for that member.

idBoardStar.description: The ID of the board star. This uniquely identifies the 'starred' relationship between the member and a board.
idBoardStar.title: Id Board Star

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member.
idMember.title: Id Member

name: remove_board_star

RemoveBoardStarResponse.description: Empty response body. The DELETE operation returns HTTP 200 OK status code on success with no content in the response body. This is standard REST API behavior for successful DELETE operations.
RemoveBoardStarResponse.title: RemoveBoardStarResponse
